newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish evacuees from Albania arrive home.
newsitem.headline: Turkish evacuees from Albania arrive home.

text.p: Two Boeing 737 aircraft carrying 245 Turks evacuated from Albania arrived at Istanbul airport via Bari in Italy on Monday morning, Anatolian news agency said.
The Turks, mostly workers and businessmen, had been taken from the Albanian port of Durres to Bari by the Turkish navy frigate Adatepe on Sunday.
Turkish newspapers said 18 elite Turkish marines had landed briefly on the Albanian coast to protect the evacuation.
Unrest erupted across southern Albania in January over the collapse of fraudulent pyramid investment schemes. It spread to most of the country in recent weeks.
